summary: Authorization bug in document upload/fetch routes: ownerRoles includes SELLER/BROKER so any authenticated seller can upload to or fetch documents for properties they don't own; fix by splitting adminRoles bypass from owner check.
findings: Document upload authorization too wide: ownerRoles includes SELLER and BROKER, so the && condition lets any broker/seller bypass the ownership check and upload documents to properties they don't own. Fix: use adminRoles for the bypass path and a separate isOwner check for everyone else. Applies to both POST /properties/:id/documents and GET /properties/:id/documents in workflows.ts.
GET /properties/:id/documents has the same over-broad ownerRoles guard — a seller can fetch another seller's documents.
Dead import in property-documents-panel.tsx: API_ORIGIN is imported from @/lib/api/client but never used in the component. Remove it.
